title: Blocks Recap
description: Track your stats over the year and then generate a yearly recap of what you did.
body:
# Blocks Recap
This mod tracks some statistics and saves it to a file on your computer. At the end of the year you can upload your statistics to a web server and then see your statistics beautifully on a website.
